scope: Named executable tests; source in test/tests directories (including helpers); supplemental named entry points and directly invoked checkers. Each path appears once. Archived evidence and delivery copies remain visible. Generated reports, captures, binary fixtures, Godot UID sidecars and data schemas are outside the executable-source census.

status.verified: This audit executed the identified module or driver locally within its stated scope. Two files in the same wire test represent one integration case.
status.explicit: A reviewed automatic invocation, discovery rule or recorded input dependency exists. No per-assertion success is claimed.
status.not found: No automatic execution route established in the reviewed entry points. Manual invocations, indirect uses and gated skips may exist.
status.archived: An evidence snapshot or supplied source delivery. This path has no execution claim. The archived three.js prototype still has an active CI workflow and is classified by that route.

candidate_delta: The candidate discovers native-kernel unittest cases, invokes the mass trace contract, adds tested telemetry health readiness and requires the real client/receiver E2E in app integration. baseline_linux_offline describes only the Linux research runner. The pinned editor and production telemetry components passed a local wire test against the real receiver. Hosted run 45075562784 also passed full application import and the real client/receiver check. Its separate offline step failed; the corrected partition fixture passed locally.

app-units: Every production-selected CI run. The checked headless runner discovers top-level test_*.gd and partitions the roster over eight shards.
app-integration: Production integration. Includes checked runtime, offline source and numerical oracle gates.
app-unit-dependency: Literal preload, import or test helper reference from an automatically selected app unit. A helper need not expose its own test case.
source-generators: Generated source freshness and offline physics invariants through app/test.sh.
offline-tools: Bounded offline measurement and test infrastructure regressions from the Linux CI integration job.
native-unittest: Audit candidate standard unittest discovery in research/native-kernel. Invokes portable test methods without invoking module CLI entry points.
mass-trace: Audit candidate seven mass/CG/fuel trace contract cases.
visuals: Required software-rendered visual capture and image contracts.
native-mac-helper: Target-specific checks in the required macOS native source job.
native-rc-runtime: Checked native ground vehicle runtime proofs.
prototype-tests: Frozen three.js prototype npm tests, Playwright capture and end-to-end commands from the main CI.
export-script: Export smoke and packaging checks on main/tag/manual when selected.
docs-ci: CI orchestration tests discovered on Linux.
queue-linux: Host queue and ownership fixtures discovered on Linux. Some individual classes require an enrolled platform.
telemetry-receiver: Path-filtered receiver unittest and Docker smoke.
telemetry-schema: Path-filtered schema/example generation and offline behavioral contracts.
metalfx-source: Path-filtered source-bound MetalFX mutation and compilation controls.
windows-queue: Path-filtered native Windows process lifetime, queue, diagnostics, and tooling fixtures.
godtest-tooling: Path-filtered macOS, Windows, and Ubuntu hosted tooling fixtures.

Its checked report recorded exit 0 and zero errors/warnings; sent=3, queued=0, dropped=0, local_drops=0. Two additional real-editor probes rejected an existing consent file and its .tmp sibling with exit 2, preserving their contents.
